summary.text: Ethan Sweetland-May is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Gary Byrne.
An account executive from New Albany, he says his campaign centers on affordability.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Ethan Sweetland-May said he was born and raised in Terre Haute in a homeschooling family of eleven children and attended Bethel School of Ministry in Redding, California.
He said he moved to New Albany in 2009 and worked for 11 years as a garbage truck operator, driver and manager, followed by five years in technical manufacturing sales.
He said his agenda focuses on reducing the cost of housing, healthcare, utilities and childcare.
